concept.name: Eagle Essence × Strike Typography
concept.summary: Premium athlete identity combining a refined eagle symbol with dynamic YĪNG lettering and Arianna Milano as the personal-brand signature.
concept.approvedReference: latest approved concept board: eagle symbol + strike-style YĪNG + ARIANNA MILANO
designIntent: no Chinese ideogram in the logo system

rules: Arianna Milano remains the personal brand.
YĪNG functions as the sport identity/signature.
The eagle symbol can stand alone only in icon-scale applications.
Never replace YĪNG with YING in final production assets.
Never add the Chinese ideogram to this logo family.

symbol.subject: eagle
symbol.construction: three abstract swept wing strokes flowing into a compact eagle head profile
symbol.wingShape: long tapered aerodynamic feathers, upward sweep, no feather clutter

head.shape: minimal curved crown and beak profile
head.neck: one open sweeping curve; avoid enclosed mascot silhouette

color.shadowIntent: subtle darker-gold depth only in large-format versions

wordmark.strokeCharacter: sharp tapered brush cuts with controlled athletic energy

redAccents.usage: two or three narrow slash accents crossing or extending from selected YĪNG strokes
redAccents.rule: red supports motion; it must never dominate the gold wordmark

macron.construction: clear horizontal macron centered over I
macron.rule: must remain legible at all non-favicon sizes

primary.symbolPosition: above and visually integrated with upper area of YĪNG
primary.clearSpaceRule: minimum clear space equals the height of the Y stroke terminal

180px.variant: sport-signature or eagle-icon depending on context

iconContainer.appIconShape: rounded square supplied by OS/app context, not part of core mark
iconContainer.rule: never draw a permanent circle or badge around the main symbol

surfaceTreatment.digitalPremiumVariant: optional subtle satin-gold gradient and micro-highlight
surfaceTreatment.texture: never bake photographic texture into the vector master
surfaceTreatment.shadow: none in master; optional 1-2% soft black depth only in presentation mockups

reconstruction.method: deterministic vector reconstruction from this specification; AI may be used only to explore shape language, never as the final production geometry
workflow: Reconstruct eagle as clean Bézier vector paths.
Reconstruct YĪNG as custom vector lettering, preserving the macron over Ī.
Create red slash accents as separate vector paths.
Typeset ARIANNA MILANO as editable text during construction, then outline only for distribution master if needed.
Create icon, signature and full-logo lockups from the same source paths.
Export exact-size raster assets from the vector master.

generationPrompt.prompt: Premium contemporary athlete logo identity on a pure black background. Create a refined abstract eagle symbol facing right: exactly three long aerodynamic gold wing strokes, flowing into a minimal elegant eagle head with a short hooked beak, open neck curve and one tiny restrained red eye. Below/integrated with it, custom dynamic strike-brush lettering spelling exactly YĪNG with a clearly visible macron over the I, satin gold with only two or three narrow deep-red motion slashes. Beneath, clean widely tracked uppercase ARIANNA MILANO in warm ivory. Luxury professional athlete branding, modern Olympic/Nike-level restraint, dynamic but elegant, no badge, no circle, no shield, no Chinese ideogram, no full bird body, no talons, no mascot/esports look, no flames, no extra words, no gradients that reduce legibility. The eagle must feel proprietary and minimal; the wordmark must remain readable. Black, satin gold, warm ivory, restrained dark red only.
generationPrompt.negativePrompt: Chinese characters, 鹰, 鷹, circle, badge, shield, full eagle, talons, open aggressive beak, esports mascot, sports team crest, flames, graffiti, excessive red, excessive gold glow, 3D chrome, bevel, unreadable YING, missing macron, YING without Ī, extra text, slogan, crown, stars

mustPass: The final wordmark reads exactly YĪNG.
The macron over Ī is visually clear.
The 16px favicon works without relying on the red eye.
The symbol is not enclosed by a circle.
The mark does not resemble an esports/team crest.
Red occupies no more than approximately 12% of the primary mark.
Arianna Milano is present in the full lockup and absent from favicon.
All variants originate from one vector master.
rejectIf: YING is used instead of YĪNG
eagle is too literal or aggressive
fine feather detail disappears at small sizes
circle becomes part of the permanent mark
brand reads as martial-arts school rather than athlete identity
